title: Avoid over-trusting convenient Option evidence
description: Repair a tiny Scala project where a method promises Either[String, String] but uses a locally convenient Option-returning parser.
expectedIntent: Preserve the Either failure channel rather than downgrading to Option or plain String.
acceptablePatchFamilies: use Parser.parseEither(raw).map(_.name) and return Either[String, String]
intentNotes: Changing userName to return Option[String] loses the explicit String failure channel.
Using parseOption preserves absence but loses typed failure information.
Using .get, throwing, or returning defaults changes the intended semantics.
Changing parser methods to erase Either changes the benchmark intent.
